item.title: Masataka Yoshida says Red Sox tenure hasn’t been what he expected
item.description: Masataka Yoshida faces an uncertain future with the Red Sox, and the Japanese standout acknowledged Saturday that his time with the club hasn't been what he expected.

item.description: ALBANY, N.Y. — No. 4 Cornell (1-0) edged UAlbany (0-1), 11-10, in NCAA men’s lacrosse on Saturday at Casey Stadium.

item.title: UConn men survive scare from Georgetown, 79-75, as Alex Karaban becomes Huskies’ all-time winner
item.description: The UConn men's basketball team survived a late scare from Georgetown to win, 79-75, on a milestone night at Gampel Pavilion.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball earns No. 1 overall seed in first NCAA Tournament top 16 reveal
item.description: In the first top 16 rankings from the NCAA Tournament selection committee, the UConn women's basketball team is projected No. 1 overall.

item.title: AT&T Pebble Beach Pro-Am: Bhatia holds on to lead, Sunday’s weather could make it interesting
item.description: With rain forecast before 11 a.m. Sunday, PGA Tour officials advanced tee times one hour to 7:22 a.m. The final group is scheduled to start at 9:45 a.m.

item.description: Keshad Johnson of the Miami Heat won the Slam Dunk contest at NBA All-Star Saturday.

item.title: ECHL: Thunder extend win streak; thrash Atlanta
item.description: ATLANTA, Ga. – Tyler Brennan made 36 saves as the Adirondack Thunder extended their win streak to five games with a 5-2 victory over the Atlanta Gladiators on Saturday night in front of 7,917 at Gas South Arena. Adirondack took an early lead as Brannon McManus set up Tag Bertuzzi, and he sent a backhand shot by goaltender Ethan Haider for the 1-0 lead. item.title: NCAA MEN’S HOCKEY: RPI offense erupts in victory against Colgate
item.description: TROY, N.Y. – The Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute (RPI) men’s ice hockey team delivered its most complete offensive performance of the season Saturday, rolling to a 6–1 home victory over Colgate. item.title: NCAA MEN’S LACROSSE: Marr stands up for Native American players, excoriates NCAA rules committee on suspensions
item.description: ALBANY, N.Y. — The University at Albany men’s lacrosse team went toe-to-toe with the No. 4 Cornell Big Red on Saturday at Casey Stadium, falling short, 11-10. After the game, Great Danes head coach Scott Marr revealed that his team was shorthanded due to suspensions stemming from a preseason scrimmage at Brown.
